architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context for global state).

tickets.title: Onboarding steps widget page (src/pages/OnboardingStepsWidget.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_widget screen to React. Extract reusable StepIndicator component. Use CSS modules for styling. Match design pixel-perfect.
acceptance_criteria: Page render without errors
StepIndicator component reusable, accept props: currentStep, totalSteps, labels
Styling match Stitch design (colors, spacing, typography)
Responsive behavior preserved

tickets.title: Onboarding web view with fixed tokens page (src/pages/OnboardingWebView.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_web_view_fixed_tokens screen. Extract TokenDisplay component. Use iframe for web view. CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Page render without errors
TokenDisplay component show fixed tokens (BTC, ETH, SOL) with correct icons, labels, values
Web view iframe load external URL (placeholder: https://svralabs.com/onboarding)
Styling match Stitch design

tickets.title: Button showcase web view page (src/pages/ButtonShowcaseWebView.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_web_view_final screen. Extract Button component with variants (primary, secondary, disabled, loading). CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Page render without errors
Button component support variants: primary, secondary, disabled, loading
Button states (hover, active, focus) match Stitch design
Showcase page display all button variants in correct layout

tickets.title: Button showcase mobile page (src/pages/ButtonShowcaseMobile.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_mobile screen. Reuse Button component from TASK-003. CSS modules for mobile-specific styling.
acceptance_criteria: Page render without errors
Mobile layout match Stitch design (stacked buttons, spacing, typography)
Button component reused from TASK-003
Responsive behavior preserved

tickets.title: Shared UI components and design tokens (src/components/, src/styles/)
tickets.description: Extract shared design tokens (colors, spacing, typography). Create shared UI components: Card, Modal. CSS variables for theming. No duplication.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens defined as CSS variables in tokens.css
Card component reusable, accept props: children, padding, shadow
Modal component reusable, accept props: isOpen, onClose, children
Components used in at least two pages

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation bar with links to all pages. React Router v6 setup. 404 page. Layout consistent across pages.
acceptance_criteria: App render without errors
Navigation bar show links to all pages (OnboardingStepsWidget, OnboardingWebView, ButtonShowcaseWebView, ButtonShowcaseMobile)
Router handle 404 with NotFound page
Layout consistent (header, footer, main content area)
